inheritance.heldout_gamma_origin: Inherited from the earlier symmetric Dl0/multishell heldout gamma grid; no asymmetric amplitudes have been evaluated at these gamma values.

prospective_pattern_hypothesis.motivation: The three calibration asymmetric gamma lanes descriptively showed a smaller D1-to-D2 relative increment than D0-to-D1 for both DVD2 and DVD3; this direction was not preregistered in calibration and therefore is tested only now on untouched heldout gammas.
prospective_pattern_hypothesis.strong_support: all 5 heldout gamma lanes satisfy lane_support
prospective_pattern_hypothesis.natural_support: at least 4 of 5 lanes satisfy lane_support

claim_lock: Heldout asymmetric support means robustness of the finite-cutoff stabilization pattern across both gamma and boundary data. It is not convergence, refinement, cylindrical consistency, continuum, bridge, novelty or new physics.
